request.prompt: Tension layer for a stealth game, meant to play underneath other music. 90 BPM, G minor, 4/4, 8 bars, steady tempo. Only: a quiet, tight sixteenth-note closed hi-hat, low sustained cellos holding G with a tremolo, and high violins slowly sliding up a half step and back. No melody, no bass guitar, no kick drum, no other instruments. Suspicious and creeping. No intro, no ending: it must loop seamlessly.
